description: Codex: Orks (11e) Blitz Brigade — UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM, charge half (WP-O34): 'Friendly WAGON units can re-roll charge rolls.' Setup: detachment Blitz Brigade; the Battlewagon moved to 42",22" with Custodian Guard Delta 6" in front of it; Custodes CP 0. Charge phase: the Battlewagon is picked, Custodian Guard Delta targeted, Declare Charge, Roll Charge (seeded): the re-roll dialog offers a FREE re-roll branded Unstoppable Momentum; a real click on Re-roll re-rolls the 2D6 without spending CP.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the fixture's Ork detachment is switched to Blitz Brigade (stratagems + detachment rules reloaded)
the charge list (the unit's row index is clicked below)

steps.script:
var cc = tree.root.get_node("Main").charge_controller
var out = []
for i in range(cc.target_list.get_item_count()):
	out.append(str(cc.target_list.get_item_metadata(i)))
print("[O34] charge targets for U_BATTLEWAGON_A: ", out)
return out.find("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_D") >= 0
